task: Develop and integrate Home Resistance Training & Cardiovascular Prescription Module for Health Agent System (Metabolic Contour)

pathology_constraints: Prior Anterior Cruciate Ligament (ACL) tear / reconstruction

architecture_rules: Streaming or indexed DB access (O(1) memory footprint)
Strict separation of LLM semantic layer and deterministic computation
No direct code modification of health_core/ during research phase

rules.day_1_2: Gastric Cmax peak, nausea & reflux window -> Cardio deload (walking only, low IAP, strictly no Valsalva or inverted positions)
rules.day_3_4: Elimination phase, normalizing GI -> Moderate session (Full Body A)
rules.day_5_6: PK Trough (lowest concentration, peak appetite/vigor) -> Primary heavy session (Full Body B), optional refeed synchronization

hard_prohibitions: Deep knee flexion > 90 degrees under load
Leg extension machine (anterior tibial shear force)
approved_mechanics: Bulgarian split squats (RFESS) with 20 deg forward torso lean

neat_and_cardio_bounds.fatmax_zone_2_formula: Karvonen Heart Rate Reserve with empirical resting HR shift (+4-8 bpm)

monitoring_triad.primary: Standardized home training log (load x reps at 3-1-1-0 tempo)
monitoring_triad.secondary: Weekly isometric handgrip dynamometry (<10% drop threshold)
monitoring_triad.decoupled_metric: Wearable HRV/RMSSD (excluded from fatigue gating due to HCN4 nodal pacing)
